remaining_gaps: General Window string property definitions and accessors remain incomplete.
Arbitrary UTF-16 Window property storage, extensibility and complete interface/prototype coverage remain incomplete.
WindowProxy, frame/named properties and cross-origin/realm behavior remain incomplete.
Full web compatibility, production security and the Chromium performance target remain unmet.
